fusions.name: Countered Incantation
fusions.desc: Pins one enemy within 7 tiles with a spoken spike that deals 10 damage, knocks it back 2 tiles and silences it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

fusions.name: Recited Lance
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds to recite, then launches a lance of force that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets within 10 tiles, always as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Glyph of Thorns
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to write a glyph beside you for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires a spike at an enemy within 6 tiles that deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Drilled Forms
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your arcane resistance rises by 8%.
